The built-in `relay-brief.md` no longer lists an owner decision as a stop, every prose line of `slicer ai relay` and `slicer ai relay-orchestrator` fits in 88 columns, the run report's rule for owner-question values is one sentence that matches what `relay-run ask` refuses, a test pins that Conformance names no `relay-run begin` or `end`, and `foreign_worktree` is tested with `GIT_DIR` set to a linked worktree's gitdir.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:** ai

**2026-10-27** — From squalify relay log (2026-10-27): (1) the role matrix has no orchestrator row, so relay-roles recommend prints 'orchestrator (no matching row)' every time; add a row or say the outer session orchestrates when the harness cannot nest subagents. (2) A small fix round is re-checked by 'the reviewer'; allow whichever read-only role already holds the findings (in squalify, resuming the gate took 30-70 s against a 72 min reviewer). (3) Ask non-blocking owner questions as they arise (while the next role runs), so an answer after the finish step does not force set --status started, a fix round, a re-gate and done again. (4) A Check item that needs another slice landed first (e.g. a corpus run after a dependency merges) has no place: the finish step had to wait for land. (5) With parallel slices, gating once on the merged result (commit branch, merge main, combined fix round, one gate) beat gate-merge-regate.

## Why

Wording findings left as later during the v1.16 relay (s394, s398, s399, s401, s406):

- `src/slicer/templates/relay-brief.md` Rules still say "Stop and report under the Stop section ... (an owner decision, repeated gate failures, or a contradictory specification)". Since s396 a `blocker` owner question is asked with `relay-run ask` and waited on, not a stop. This project's customized copy (`slicer template list` says `relay-brief.md customized`) carries the same line.
- s401 and s399 added contract lines far over the 88 columns the rest of the prose keeps (for example the Slice relay opening paragraph at 111 and the `spec_check` Setup bullet at 133). Other lines are longer still: the vendor-limit paragraph (`RELAY_LIMIT_FALLBACK`) is one line of 1217 characters and the orchestrator's Waiting rule has lines of 129 to 175. Only the Gate criteria have a width test (`test_RelayGate_CriteriaSentence_IsWrappedLikeTheRestOfTheProse`, 90).
- s398 L3: the orchestrator's Run report says "Use no `|` in any value but `reasoning`, and no `;` in a SUMMARY", but `relayrun.question_fields` also refuses `;` in a label and ends the label at the first `:`. The sentence and the check should be one rule from one source, shared by the run report, `relay-run ask` (s396) and the spec check's `owner needed` lines.
- s406: Conformance binds a program as well as an agent; the outer session owns `begin` and `end`, so a test should pin that Conformance never tells an orchestrator to run them (it says "The outer session begins and ends the run" today).
- s394: the comment above `_REPO_POINTER_ENV` in `src/slicer/vcs.py` says a merge driver runs with the repo pointers "set to the project's repo". In a linked worktree `GIT_DIR` names that worktree's gitdir (`<common dir>/worktrees/NAME`), not the repo's `.git`. Neither test in `tests/test_code_location.py` covers that value. (Unverified that git sets `GIT_DIR` for a merge driver in exactly that form; the implementer confirms with a real merge in a linked worktree, as s394's reviewer did.)

Owner decision 2026-10-30: every v1.17 change lands at v10 text and s424 bumps to v11 once, last. Nothing here changes a rule.
